name: BIT Capital GmbH
headcount: 45 employees worldwide, including ~10 engineers, data scientists and product managers
positioning: Germany's largest asset manager specialising in actively managed technology equity funds.

quotes.text: Our goal is to understand companies just as well as the CEO does.
Technology scales human judgment: AI systems detect patterns. Human analysis assesses relevance and investment implications.
Investment ideas are generated strictly bottom-up, from the analysis of secular technology trends, data-driven screening models.
More than 75% of all trades are now influenced by this systematic data infrastructure.

process.detail: Business models, competition and technological innovation; secular technology trends plus data-driven screens.
Concentrate on the companies judged to be structural winners in their segment.
Classic bottom-up analysis; the stated goal is to understand the company as well as its CEO does.
Proprietary and expert-network inputs alongside the quantitative signals.
Bottom-up KPI monitoring for valuation extremes; a macro team running a proprietary five-factor regime and liquidity model; an independent Risk Committee reviewing VaR and liquidity stress monthly.
Positions above 5% of NAV must survive 'Devil's Advocate' sessions where analysts defend the thesis against negative scenarios.
Positions adjusted or closed when expectations, data or valuation deteriorate.
Highly active management with high turnover; human judgment remains the final authority.
